rows.q: 已完成订单的金额合计
rows.sql: SELECT SUM(total_amt) FROM dwd_order WHERE status = '已完成';
SELECT order_id FROM dwd_order WHERE status = '已退款';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dwd_order WHERE status = '待处理';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dwd_order WHERE status = '已取消';

rows.q: 统计所有已完成和待处理订单
rows.sql: SELECT * FROM dwd_order WHERE status IN ('已完成', '待处理');
SELECT SUM(total_amt) FROM dwd_order WHERE status = '退款';
SELECT * FROM dwd_order WHERE status <> 'completed';

rows.q: 按状态分组统计订单数
rows.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM dwd_order GROUP BY status;

rows.q: 已完成的订单按渠道汇总
rows.sql:
SELECT chan_id, SUM(total_amt) AS total_amt_sum, SUM(xse) AS xse_sum
FROM dwd_order
WHERE status = '已完成'
GROUP BY chan_id;
SELECT * FROM dwd_order WHERE status <> '已取消';

rows.q: 已完成订单的金额合计
rows.sql: SELECT SUM(total_amt) FROM dwd_order WHERE status = 'completed';
SELECT order_id FROM dwd_order WHERE status = 'refunded';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dwd_order WHERE status = 'pending';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dwd_order WHERE status = 'cancelled';

rows.q: 统计所有已完成和待处理订单
rows.sql: SELECT * FROM dwd_order WHERE status IN ('completed', 'pending');
SELECT SUM(total_amt) FROM dwd_order WHERE status = 'refunded';
SELECT * FROM dwd_order WHERE status NOT IN ('completed', 'refunded');

rows.q: 按状态分组统计订单数
rows.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM dwd_order GROUP BY status;

rows.q: 已完成的订单按渠道汇总
rows.sql: SELECT chan_id, SUM(total_amt) AS total_amt FROM dwd_order WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY chan_id;
SELECT * FROM dwd_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled';
